query: "MBSE Challenges in the Concurrent Preliminary Design of CubeSats: Nanospace Study"

results.title: MBSE Challenges in the Concurrent Preliminary Design of CubeSats: Nanospace Study
results.abstract: In this paper, the early endeavours of the incorporation of a Model-based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approach to the open-source Nanospace framework is discussed, presenting the challenges that need to be overcome for such an integration. Nanospace is a web application dedicated to facilitate concurrent engineering during the preliminary design phase of CubeSats. CubeSats provide a progression of educational and research opportunities, and have had increased the accessibility to space for non-space fairing nations. CubeSats and their subsystems interfaces have been studied numerous times. Nanospace may benefit from MBSE, as MBSE facilitates knowledge reuse; which could allow a faster design convergence and faster inspection of candidate architectures.
